selected_evidence.summary: Direct stat output shows `/srv/drop` is owned by root:root with mode 1777; final checks confirm both unprivileged users have write access.

selected_evidence.requirement: Users cannot remove files owned by other users
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, both cross-user deletion attempts failed with `Operation not permitted`, while file creation and owner cleanup succeeded.
Evidence captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, matching persistent-data checksum, recovered mode and behavior, and clean final state.

commands.command:
set -eu
cat /etc/os-release
id
if [ -e /srv/drop ]; then stat -c 'path=%n type=%F mode=%a symbolic=%A owner=%U group=%G' /srv/drop; else printf 'path=/srv/drop state=absent\n'; fi
commands.stdout:
NAME="Alpine Linux"
ID=alpine
VERSION_ID=3.23.3
PRETTY_NAME="Alpine Linux v3.23"
HOME_URL="https://alpinelinux.org/"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/issues"
uid=0(root) gid=0(root)
path=/srv/drop state=absent

commands.command:
getent passwd nobody daemon 2>/dev/null || awk -F: '$1 == "nobody" || $1 == "daemon" {print}' /etc/passwd
command -v su

set -eu
mkdir -p /srv/drop
chown root:root /srv/drop
chmod 1777 /srv/drop
stat -c 'path=%n type=%F mode=%a symbolic=%A owner=%U group=%G' /srv/drop
commands.stdout: path=/srv/drop type=directory mode=1777 symbolic=drwxrwxrwt owner=root group=root

commands.command:
set -eu
rm -f /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon /tmp/sticky-deny-1 /tmp/sticky-deny-2
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c "printf 'owned-by-nobody\n' > /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody"
su daemon -s /bin/sh -c "printf 'owned-by-daemon\n' > /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon"
stat -c 'created=%n owner=%U mode=%a' /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon
if su daemon -s /bin/sh -c 'rm /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody' 2>/tmp/sticky-deny-1; then printf 'daemon_delete_nobody=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'daemon_delete_nobody=denied\n'; fi
cat /tmp/sticky-deny-1
test -f /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody
if su nobody -s /bin/sh -c 'rm /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon' 2>/tmp/sticky-deny-2; then printf 'nobody_delete_daemon=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'nobody_delete_daemon=denied\n'; fi
cat /tmp/sticky-deny-2
test -f /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c 'rm /srv/drop/.sticky-test-nobody'
su daemon -s /bin/sh -c 'rm /srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon'
printf 'own_file_cleanup=passed\n'

daemon_delete_nobody=denied

nobody_delete_daemon=denied
rm: can't remove '/srv/drop/.sticky-test-daemon': Operation not permitted
own_file_cleanup=passed

commands.command:
set -eu
rm -f /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-marker
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c "printf 'sticky-drop-persistence-v1\n' > /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-marker"
printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
stat -c 'directory=%n mode=%a symbolic=%A owner=%U group=%G' /srv/drop
stat -c 'data=%n owner=%U size=%s mode=%a' /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-marker
sha256sum /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-marker
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c 'test -w /srv/drop'
su daemon -s /bin/sh -c 'test -w /srv/drop'
printf 'writers=nobody,daemon status=writable\n'

0aa419251e9995e17569e350fe2340b84c4c391edf8e5fbcb8dc215e450a8ae8  /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-marker

commands.command:
set -eu
sync
nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; /sbin/reboot' >/tmp/antrieb-reboot.log 2>&1 </dev/null &
printf 'reboot_ack=node1 scheduled current_boot_id=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"

set -eu
old_boot_id='17484929-0541-48dc-9d52-0a8317d90b3f'
new_boot_id="$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
test "$new_boot_id" != "$old_boot_id"
printf 'boot_identity old=%s new=%s changed=yes\n' "$old_boot_id" "$new_boot_id"
test "$(stat -c %a /srv/drop)" = 1777
test "$(stat -c %U:%G /srv/drop)" = root:root
stat -c 'directory=%n mode=%a symbolic=%A owner=%U group=%G' /srv/drop
test -f /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-marker
actual_sum="$(sha256sum /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-marker | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$actual_sum" = '0aa419251e9995e17569e350fe2340b84c4c391edf8e5fbcb8dc215e450a8ae8'
printf 'persistent_data_sha256=%s match=yes\n' "$actual_sum"
rm -f /srv/drop/.post-restart-nobody /srv/drop/.post-restart-daemon /tmp/post-deny-1 /tmp/post-deny-2
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c "printf 'post-restart-nobody\n' > /srv/drop/.post-restart-nobody"
su daemon -s /bin/sh -c "printf 'post-restart-daemon\n' > /srv/drop/.post-restart-daemon"
stat -c 'post_restart_created=%n owner=%U' /srv/drop/.post-restart-nobody /srv/drop/.post-restart-daemon
if su daemon -s /bin/sh -c 'rm /srv/drop/.post-restart-nobody' 2>/tmp/post-deny-1; then printf 'post_restart_cross_delete=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'daemon_delete_nobody_post_restart=denied\n'; fi
cat /tmp/post-deny-1
if su nobody -s /bin/sh -c 'rm /srv/drop/.post-restart-daemon' 2>/tmp/post-deny-2; then printf 'post_restart_cross_delete=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'nobody_delete_daemon_post_restart=denied\n'; fi
cat /tmp/post-deny-2
test -f /srv/drop/.post-restart-nobody
test -f /srv/drop/.post-restart-daemon
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c 'rm /srv/drop/.post-restart-nobody /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-marker'
su daemon -s /bin/sh -c 'rm /srv/drop/.post-restart-daemon'
printf 'post_restart_recovery=healthy test_artifacts=cleaned\n'
